name: KeliBoard
blurb: KeliBoard is a modern, actively maintained HeliBoard fork focused on stability, usability, and first-class language support.
description:
KeliBoard is a modern, actively maintained HeliBoard fork focused on stability, usability, and first-class language support.

It is privacy-conscious, fully open source, and works offline without the internet permission.

Highlights:

• Fixes for long-standing keyboard, composition, emoji, and spacing issues

• First-class Korean support, including Cheonjiin and Korean QWERTY layouts

• Customizable layouts, themes, colors, icons, fonts, and background images

• Dictionaries for suggestions and spell checking

• Multilingual typing

• Clipboard history

• One-handed and split keyboard modes

• Number pad

• Backup and restore for settings and learned data

Korean is a flagship feature, not the limit of the project. KeliBoard remains a general-purpose keyboard for HeliBoard users in every language.

KeliBoard is based on HeliBoard, which is based on AOSP and OpenBoard. Upstream attribution and licenses are preserved.
